comments.content: The `AIMODataset` branch hardcodes `dataset_split` to `"train"`, ignoring the user-provided `--hf-split` argument. This is inconsistent with the other branches (e.g. `VisionArenaDataset` uses `args.hf_split`) and with the README example which explicitly passes `--hf-split train`. If a user passes a different split, it will be silently ignored. Consider using `args.hf_split` here for consistency, or document why the split is forced.
